_meta.dataset: Crude grade classes + refinery compatibility bands
_meta.source: API gravity / sulphur classification per standard petroleum conventions (EIA definitions)
_meta.notes: Grades bucketed into classes for the grade-compatibility hard constraint. class = f(api_gravity, sulphur). A refinery accepts a set of classes (see refineries.json accepts_classes). Real refineries have finer assay windows; these bands are a defensible simplification, labeled DEMO.
